name: pre-read-strict-unrecorded-writer-denies-with-the-write-wording
description: The <unknown>-writer arm of the WRITE deny template, on BOTH backends. Fixture 09 used to carry it and no longer can: since R8 its scenario (a grant taken with no commit) takes the grant-change template instead, which names no writer at all. The arm is still reachable, and this is how: B pre-reads CLAUDE.md first, seeding v1 with B's hash and NO last_writer_id (a first observation is not a commit). A then pre-reads the same strict-tracked path for the FIRST time, offering different bytes. A has no prior grant, so nothing about a grant changed hands and the summary cannot call the version unchanged; the diverging hash says something WAS written, out of band. The deny therefore uses the write template -- and names 'agent <unknown>', preserved verbatim rather than [:8]-sliced to the malformed '<unknown'. Timestamps vary per run; the reason bytes and the summary shape are the contract.

hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecisionReason: Stale read denied: CLAUDE.md was updated by agent <unknown> at <TS>. Re-read CLAUDE.md via the Read tool before proceeding. This denial is structural (v0.2 strict mode); retrying the same operation will produce the same denial.
